杯.meaning: At a picnic under a <part>tree</part>, you lift a jam jar to make a toast, and the tree waves a <part>negative</part> sign: no, not like that! It drops a glass from a branch, tall-stemmed and shining: a proper <kanji>wine glass</kanji>.
杯.on: The bees from a nearby <sound>hi</sound>ve buzz down to clink glasses with you.
杯.kun: You raise your glass with a <sound>sa</sound>rdine, a <sound>ca</sound>rp, a seal from the <sound>zoo</sound> and a man holding a golden <sound>key</sound>.

差.meaning: A <part>sheep</part> stands on a <part>workbench</part> to be measured against its twin, and a <part>slash</part> of chalk marks where each head comes up to. One is a hair taller. The judge squints at the tiny <kanji>distinction</kanji>.
差.on: The twins get a prize anyway: one <sound>sa</sound>rdine each, exactly the same size.
差.kun: The judge raises a <sound>sa</sound>rdine and points it at the taller twin: to point, to hold up.

故.meaning: An <part>old</part> man waves a <part>fan</part> to cool himself, and the breeze knocks a teacup off the shelf, which rolls into a cat, which leaps into the soup. Nobody meant any of it. It was all <kanji>happenstance</kanji>.
故.on: Then a sleepy <sound>ko</sound>ala falls out of a tree and lands in the soup too.
故.kun: '<sound>You</sound> did this!' the old man tells the cat, who blinks and lays an <sound>e</sound>gg in reply.

現.meaning: A <part>king</part> points a <part>camera</part> at you and shouts: 'Smile!' Click. Not yesterday, not tomorrow: the photo shows you right here, right now, in the <kanji>present</kanji>.
現.on: 'Smile, <sound>Gen</sound>!' the king tells his little dog, and snaps it one more time, right now.
現.kun: '<sound>Ah</sound>! <sound>Rah</sound>! <sound>Wah</sound>!' yells the crowd, as the king himself appears in the photo.

実.meaning: Under your <part>roof</part> stands the <part>Christmas tree</part> you thought you'd only dreamed of. You poke it, and real needles prick your finger. Real fruit hangs from its branches. It's no dream: it's <kanji>reality</kanji>.
実.on: '<sound>Gee</sound>!' you gasp, then sneeze at the pine smell: '<sound>Tsu</sound>!'
実.kun: A <sound>mee</sound>rkat climbs the tree and picks you a piece of fruit.

房.meaning: A <part>door</part> has a little <part>sail</part> tied to its handle, and from the bottom of the sail hangs a fluffy bunch of threads that swings each time the door opens. Swish, swish: a <kanji>tassel</kanji>.
房.on: A <sound>bou</sound>lder rolls past the door, and the tassel waves at it.
房.kun: The cat swats the tassel instead of eating its <sound>foo</sound>d, a fat <sound>sa</sound>rdine.

作.meaning: A carpenter hangs his apron on a <part>coat hook</part>, then builds a whole <part>coat rack</part> out of spare planks, one peg at a time. Hammer, saw, glue. Give him some wood and he'll <kanji>make</kanji> something.
作.on: Then he plants a fat <sound>suc</sound>culent on top of the rack for decoration.
作.kun: '<sound>Tsu</sound>!' he sneezes in the sawdust, and a <sound>cu</sound>ckoo pops out of a clock he made.
